original.statement: Loki now automatically enables an embedded cache if no other cache backend is explicitly configured.

corrected.statement: Loki 3.0.0 now enables the embedded cache when no other cache is explicitly enabled.

decision.reason: [ev-629a38c6f4b2] says only that Loki 3.0.0 now enables the embedded cache when no other cache is explicitly enabled. That is a change in what the same configuration does, so behavior-changed is the right change type. The evidence names no config key, so a free-form protocol-behavior subject is the only family that fits. However, the proposed name adds "default", a word the evidence never uses, so I've trimmed the name to "embedded-cache-enablement", built from the evidence's own words.
